text:
Elaine (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the next-model slate for the Q3 catalog by Friday. Several customer asks for a 70B variant but cost/latency risk is high. Thinking we should use a quick RICE to decide sequencing. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Miguel (Eng): Can you drop the initial R/I/C/E numbers? I can run throughput & cost sims after that.
Elaine (PM): Draft RICE below for two options (rough, 0-10 scales):
```
Mistral-7B-quant: Reach=5, Impact=7, Confidence=6, Effort=4  -> RICE ≈ 52.5
Llama-70B-full:   Reach=3, Impact=9, Confidence=5, Effort=9  -> RICE ≈ 15
```
Mistral wins on RICE but customers (enterprise) are explicitly asking for 70B quality for rerank and multi-turn.
Samir (ML): Agree with the RICE math. Couple of notes: 7B + good prompt engineering + small RLHF gives decent gen quality; however reranking/long-context retrieval tasks still favor 70B. Proposal: onboard 7B to hosted catalog fast, and run 70B as Dedicated pilot for paying customers.
Olivia (Sales): Sales signal: 2 enterprises (SableHealth, FinFlow) said they'd sign pilot contracts if we support a 70B Dedicated offering with SLA and audit logs. They accept a private pilot price. :money_with_wings:
Kevin (SRE): Operational constraints: 70B requires reserved GPU capacity and different autoscaling. We should set a hard gating: p50 latency <= 600ms and controlled p95 under load. Also need an automatic fallback routing to 7B when queue length exceeds threshold.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment created: canary/llama-70b -> 3 nodes (region: us-west2).
Miguel (Eng): Perf notes: unquantized 70B is ~3-4x cost of 7B on our fleet. Int8 quant reduces to ~1.8x but may introduce regressions. I can run perf+quality evals if we define the eval set.
Samir (ML): Suggest launch criteria checklist for 70B Dedicated pilot:
- Eval pass on 5 representative customer prompt suites (coverage: rerank, multi-turn, long-context)
- Cost per 1M tokens on Dedicated <= $X (TBD) with quantization options explored
- Fallback routing and tracing enabled + docs for SEs
- Rollout plan: canary -> pilot customers -> GA decision after 4-week pilot
Elaine (PM): I'll create a RICE card in the repo and assign owners. @Olivia can you confirm which customers are eligible for pilot? @Miguel can you run perf numbers and a small int8 vs fp16 quality check by Wed?
Olivia (Sales): Confirmed: SableHealth + FinFlow are interested, also IntroBeta customer (FinFlow) wants to try but needs SOC2 + IP filtering. I'll collect their prompt suites.
Miguel (Eng): On it — will post perf numbers and a quick eval matrix in this thread within 24h.
Samir (ML): Also recommend we add an eval for hallucination rate on the 70B quantized variant — small regression acceptable but need to quantify.
Elaine (PM): Sounds good. Outcome for now: sequence 7B for hosted GA, 70B as gated Dedicated pilot with the criteria above. I'll write the proposal and scope the ticket. :white_check_mark:
Kevin (SRE): I'll draft the fallback routing policy and required infra checklist.
Elaine (PM): Thanks all — keeping this short. Will follow up with the RICE card and tickets. :pray:
